qualification: Literal descriptor/callback expectations, statically traced from six exact canonical source exports; not a native execution result. Callback inputs are synthetic, not appliance measurements.

model_policy.root_name: Configured synthetic device name seeds the otherwise hardware-generated GR-Gcloud_60_0a_<NIC suffix>_E5 cache.
model_policy.rssi: Chosen -50 dBm peripheral readout; no physical radio quality claim.
model_policy.GcloudHid: Empty UART tuple readout; no companion HID invented.
model_policy.clock: Per-root Unix epoch at first root request, monotonic elapsed seconds, UTC unless an evidenced appStdTime offset/TZ is set. No SNTP or host timezone mutation.
model_policy.identity: mac/mid/hid writes mutate reported root metadata only; configured UDP routing and child ownership stay immutable. key writes replace the two actual AES slots after whole-batch validation.
model_policy.events: Qualified local cloud/configuration posts retain their event identifier; no delivery, firmware download, reboot, Wi-Fi connection, or physical side effect is claimed.
model_policy.atomicity: Whole packet is staged, including getter cache updates and local events; oversized replies and invalid keys do not mutate state.
model_policy.nested_callbacks: dat/res parameter setters route a six-NIC-byte plus literal00 identity to registered child category selectors/updaters; root dat/res caches remain null. Unknown target failures echo the requested nested value; no companion delivery is claimed.
model_policy.unknown_fields: Unknown properties echo requested command val but remain absent from fresh status.
